method: Four laterals on frozen S3A maps. Starboard is a new positive-scale instance with inboard −X sockets and +90° aft yaw. Drive gated by all four capture groups.

exclusions: hinge-face: *HINGE_BARREL vs vane/book at |sep|<1e-4 (S1 G1 class)
shoe/carriage wrap vs own rail beam (designed socket wrap)
nest-pin vs nest-receiver frame (designed through-bore; solids must not overlap — tested separately as approach)
own socket rail/stop: RR/FR INNER|OUTER vs own RAIL_BEAM/STOP — homologous to certified port book occupancy of the rail end (port S1 does not fail this pair; the stop sits inside the book planform)

gates.name: Starboard rear truth
gates.detail: self=-0.0000@0.0000 RR_INNER_ARMOR/RR_OUTER_ARMOR; latch=0.0050; own=0.0500; central=s4-rear minFixedSep=0.587

gates.name: Bilateral inter-side clearance
